exposure: daily dosing of gentamicin using ideal body weight
traditional every 8 hours dosing of gentamicin
Daily dosing of gentamicin using ideal body weight
cohort: 500 women receiving treatment for intrapartum chorioamnionitis at two large academic centers
finding: Daily dosing of gentamicin using ideal body weight is associated with a lower risk of postpartum endometritis and high chance of a successful outcome in the treatment of intrapartum chorioamnionitis compared with traditional 8-hour dosing.
